appId.description: The App ID from your Feihan Admin Console (Workplace > App Management > App Details)

appSecret.description: The App Secret from your Feihan Admin Console (keep this value confidential)

backendUrl.description: Your Feihan server address, e.g. http://192.168.10.10:21000

enabled.description: Whether this account is active (set to false to temporarily disable without removing)

enableEncryption.description: Use encrypted communication between OpenClaw and Feihan server

requestTimeout.description: How long to wait for a response from Feihan server before timing out (in milliseconds)
